rows.source_ko: 성평등가족부 (혁신행정법무담당관), 02-2100-6082
rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Division ), 02-2100-6082

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 성평등가족부에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 실장ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「성평등가족부 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels of auxiliary and advisory agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2(3) and (5) of the Government Organization Act, and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 성평등가족부
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: 제2조(대변인) ① 대변인은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 대변인 밑에 홍보담당관 및 디지털소통팀장 각 1명을 두며, 홍보담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 디지털소통팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② One Public Relations Officer and one Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed under the Spokesperson. The Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Computer Science Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 홍보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 주요 정책에 관한 홍보계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 정책ㆍ사업별 홍보 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of publicity plans regarding major policies related to gender equality, women, family, and youth, and support for promotion by policy and project

rows.source_ko: 2. 부 내 업무의 대외정책 발표에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the announcement of external policies regarding internal affairs

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 정책에 대한 브리핑 지원 등 정책홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning policy promotion, such as support for briefings on major policies

rows.source_ko: 4. 보도자료 관리 및 언론사 관련 업무의 지원ㆍ협조
rows.text_en: 4. Management of press releases and support and cooperation regarding media-related affairs

rows.source_ko: 5. 오보ㆍ왜곡보도에 대한 대응 및 건전한 비판 분석ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Response to False and Distorted Reporting, and Analysis and Management of Sound Criticism

rows.source_ko: 6. 광고 등 홍보영상물 제작 협의 및 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and support for the production of promotional videos, such as advertisements

rows.source_ko: 7. 부 내 홍보실적의 관리 및 평가
rows.text_en: 7. Management and Evaluation of Internal Public Relations Performance

rows.source_ko: ④ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 디지털소통 홍보계획 수립 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Operation of Digital Communication & Promotion Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 디지털소통 채널 운영 및 홍보 콘텐츠 제작ㆍ활용
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of digital communication channels and production and utilization of promotional content

rows.source_ko: 3. 장관 및 차관 정책활동에 대한 온라인 홍보
rows.text_en: 3. Online promotion of the Minister and Vice Minister's policy activities

rows.source_ko: 4. 성평등가족부 홈페이지의 콘텐츠 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Content Management of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Website

rows.source_ko: 5. 부 내 디지털소통 활동의 점검 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Review and Evaluation of Digital Communication Activities within the Department

rows.source_ko: 제3조(정책보좌관) 정책보좌관 중 1명은 고위공무원단에 속하는 별정직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. 다만, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 대체하여 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Policy Advisor) One of the policy advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기획조정실장) ① 기획조정실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 공무원으로 보하되 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of the Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「성평등가족부 직제」 제6조제1항에 따라 기획조정실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책기획관으로 하며, 정책기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family,” the advisory body placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination shall be the Policy Planning Officer, and the Policy Planning Officer shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제6조제3항 각 호의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Policy Planning assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획재정담당관, 혁신행정법무담당관, 국제협력담당관 및 정보통계담당관 각 1명을 두되, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ④ One Planning and Finance Officer, one Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, one International Cooperation Officer, and one Information and Statistics Officer shall be appointed under the Director of Planning and Coordination, and each Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Planning and Finance Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 주요 정책에 대한 계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and overall management of plans for major policies related to gender equality, women, family, and youth

rows.source_ko: 2. 국정감사, 인사청문회, 당정협의 등 국회 관련 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of National Assembly-related affairs, such as parliamentary audits, confirmation hearings, and party-government consultations

rows.source_ko: 3. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 정책의 중장기 비전 및 전략 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Mid-to-Long-Term Vision and Strategy for Policies Related to Gender Equality, Women, Family, and Youth

rows.source_ko: 4. 각종 공약ㆍ지시사항의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of various pledges and directives

rows.source_ko: 5. 부 내 정책과 관련된 각종 정보ㆍ의제의 발굴ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Discovery and management of various information and agendas related to internal ministry policies

rows.source_ko: 6. 부 내 정책의 중앙부처 및 지방자치단체와의 협의ㆍ조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of consultation and coordination of internal policies with central government ministries and local governments

rows.source_ko: 7. 부 내 행정협업 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management and coordination of administrative collaboration tasks within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 8. 부 내 정책 간 연계성 확보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning ensuring linkage between policies within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 9. 세입ㆍ세출예산 편성 및 배정, 집행의 조정 및 결산
rows.text_en: 9. Formulation and allocation of revenue and expenditure budgets, coordination of execution, and settlement of accounts

rows.source_ko: 10. 부 내 정책연구용역사업의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management and coordination of policy research service projects within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 11. 성평등가족부 소관 기금의 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Management of funds under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officers within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 혁신행정법무담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 부 내 행정관리업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of administrative affairs within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 2. 부 내 업무 개선과제의 발굴ㆍ선정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Identification, selection, and management of internal business improvement tasks

rows.source_ko: 3. 조직문화 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the improvement of organizational culture

rows.source_ko: 4. 부 내 국정과제의 점검
rows.text_en: 4. Review of national policy tasks within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 5. 조직진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of Organization and Staffing through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 6. 부 내 정부위원회의 관리 및 정책자문위원회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the management of government committees within the Ministry and the operation of the Policy Advisory Committee

rows.source_ko: 7. 주요 사업의 진도파악 및 정부업무평가의 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Monitoring the progress of major projects and overall management of government performance evaluations

rows.source_ko: 8. 성과관리계획의 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of Performance Management Plan and Overall Management and Coordination

rows.source_ko: 9. 주요 정책 등에 대한 자체평가 계획의 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of self-evaluation plans for major policies, etc., and overall management and coordination

rows.source_ko: 10. 부 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 점검 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks within the Ministry, and monitoring and management of implementation status

rows.source_ko: 11. 성평등가족부 소관 공공기관 경영평가 등 관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 11. Overall management of management evaluations, etc., of public institutions under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: 12. 부 소관 법령안의 입안ㆍ심사 및 법규집의 편찬ㆍ발간
rows.text_en: 12. Drafting and examination of bills under the jurisdiction of the Ministry, and compilation and publication of legal codes

rows.source_ko: 13. 부 내 규제개혁 및 정비에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning regulatory reform and streamlining within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 14. 국무회의 및 차관회의의 안건 검토
rows.text_en: 14. Review of agendas for the Cabinet and Vice-Ministers' Meetings

rows.source_ko: 15. 부 소관 행정심판ㆍ소송사무 및 법령 질의회신의 총괄
rows.text_en: 15. Overall management of administrative appeals, litigation, and legal inquiries and responses under the jurisdiction of the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 16. 부 소관 비영리법인 및 민간단체의 등록에 관한 사항의 총괄
rows.text_en: 16. Overall management of matters concerning the registration of non-profit corporations and private organizations under the jurisdiction of the Ministry

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 국제협력담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The International Cooperation Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 국제협력에 관한 계획의 수립 및 국제교류 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of plans for international cooperation related to gender equality, women, family, and youth, and overall management of international exchange affairs

rows.source_ko: 2. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 분야의 국제협력 사업
rows.text_en: 2. International cooperation projects in the fields of gender equality, women, family, and youth

rows.source_ko: 3. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 분야의 국제기구ㆍ국제회의 및 외국 정부와의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning cooperation with international organizations, international conferences, and foreign governments in the fields of gender equality, women, family, and youth

rows.source_ko: 4. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 정책 관련 국제협약의 이행 평가
rows.text_en: 4. Evaluation of the Implementation of International Conventions on Gender Equality, Women, Family, and Youth Policies

rows.source_ko: 5. 개발도상국의 여성발전 지원 등 부 내 대외원조 사업 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of the Ministry's foreign aid projects, including support for women's development in developing countries

rows.source_ko: 6. 여성의 국제전문인력 육성 및 국제기구 진출의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the fostering of women's international expertise and support for their entry into international organizations

rows.source_ko: 7. 민간부문의 여성 국제활동의 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for Women's International Activities in the Private Sector

rows.source_ko: 8. 남북한 여성교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning women's exchange and cooperation between South and North Korea

rows.source_ko: 9. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 해외 자료의 수집ㆍ보급
rows.text_en: 9. Collection and distribution of overseas materials related to gender equality, women, family, and youth

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 정보통계담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Information and Statistics Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 관련 정보화 계획의 수립 및 평가
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and evaluation of informatization plans related to gender equality, women, family, and youth

rows.source_ko: 2. 부 내 정보화(인공지능에 관한 사항을 포함하며, 이하 같다) 관련 정책의 총괄 및 정보화 예산의 사전검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of policies related to informatization within the Ministry (including matters concerning artificial intelligence, hereinafter the same) and prior review and coordination of the informatization budget

rows.source_ko: 3. 정보화 관련 사업의 연계ㆍ통합 및 조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the linkage, integration, and coordination of informatization-related projects

rows.source_ko: 4. 부 내 정보자원 관리계획의 수립 및 정보기술아키텍처 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of internal information resource management plans and construction and operation of information technology architecture

rows.source_ko: 5. 부 내 업무포털 및 행정정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and operation of internal business portals and administrative information systems

rows.source_ko: 6. 성평등ㆍ여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년 정책 관련 정보시스템의 구축 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Support for the establishment of information systems related to gender equality, women, family, and youth policies

rows.source_ko: 7. 부 내 정보보안 및 개인정보 보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning information security and personal information protection within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 8. 직원 정보화능력의 향상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the improvement of employees' IT capabilities

rows.source_ko: 9. 부 내 전산자원 및 정보통신망의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 9. Management and operation of internal computer resources and information and communications networks

rows.source_ko: 10. 성평등가족부 홈페이지의 구축 및 시스템 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Construction and System Management of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Website

rows.source_ko: 11. 부 내 통계업무의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 자체통계 품질진단의 실시
rows.text_en: 11. Overall management and coordination of statistical work within the Ministry and implementation of internal statistical quality diagnoses

rows.source_ko: 12. 부 내 공공데이터의 제공 및 이용 활성화에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 평가 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Overall management of the establishment, implementation, and evaluation of plans regarding the provision and promotion of the use of public data within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 13. 부 내 데이터기반행정 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 데이터 관리 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management of planning, implementation, and data management for the activation of data-based administration within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 제5조(감사담당관) 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>

rows.text_en: Article 6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(성평등정책실) ① 성평등정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Gender Equality Policy Office) ① The Head of the Gender Equality Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「성평등가족부 직제」 제9조제1항에 따라 성평등정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 성평등정책관, 고용평등정책관 및 안전인권정책관으로 하며, 성평등정책관, 고용평등정책관 및 안전인권정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Gender Equality Policy Office shall be the Director of Gender Equality Policy, the Director of Employment Equality Policy, and the Director of Safety and Human Rights Policy; the Director of Gender Equality Policy, the Director of Employment Equality Policy, and the Director of Safety and Human Rights Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 성평등정책관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제9조제3항제1호부터 제11호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Gender Equality Policy assists the Director-General with respect to matters under Article 9, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 11 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 고용평등정책관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제9조제3항제12호부터 제24호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Employment Equality Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 12 through 24 of Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 안전인권정책관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제9조제3항제25호부터 제47호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of Safety and Human Rights Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 25 through 47 of Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 성평등정책실에 성형평성기획과, 성평등정책과, 성평등문화협력과, 성별영향평가과, 고용평등총괄과, 경제활동촉진과, 경력이음지원과, 권익정책과, 성폭력방지과, 디지털성범죄방지과, 친밀관계폭력방지과, 폭력예방교육과, 아동청소년성보호과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Gender Equality Policy Office shall have the Gender Equality Planning Division, Gender Equality Policy Division, Gender Equality Culture Cooperation Division, Gender Impact Assessment Division, Employment Equality General Division, Economic Activity Promotion Division, Career Connection Support Division, Rights Policy Division, Sexual Violence Prevention Division, Digital Sexual Crime Prevention Division, Intimate Relationship Violence Prevention Division, Violence Prevention Education Division, and Child and Youth Sexual Protection Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「여성의 경제활동 촉진과 경력단절 예방법」 제2조제1호에 따른 경력보유여성등(이하 “경력보유여성등”이라 한다)을 위한 취업촉진 사업의 개발ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 1. Development and promotion of employment promotion projects for women with careers, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “women with careers, etc.”) pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the “Act on the Promotion of Women’s Economic Activities and Prevention of Career Interruption.”

rows.source_ko: 2. 여성의 경력유지 및 개발을 위한 지원 사업
rows.text_en: 2. Support Programs for Women's Career Maintenance and Development

rows.source_ko: 3. 여성의 경력단절 예방을 위한 사회적ㆍ문화적 인식 개선 사업
rows.text_en: 3. Social and cultural awareness improvement projects to prevent career interruptions for women

rows.source_ko: 4. 경력보유여성등의 직무역량을 위한 직업교육훈련 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of vocational education and training for the job competencies of women with career experience, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 경력보유여성등의 직장 적응을 위한 새일여성인턴사업 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the New Job Women Internship Program to help women with work experience adapt to the workplace

rows.source_ko: 6. 경력보유여성등의 창업 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning support for entrepreneurship for women with career experience, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 경력보유여성등의 경력이음 사례관리 사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the Career Connection Case Management Project for Women with Career Experience, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 여성경제활동지원센터의 지정ㆍ운영ㆍ기능 활성화 및 평가
rows.text_en: 8. Designation, Operation, Functional Enhancement, and Evaluation of Women's Economic Activity Support Centers

rows.source_ko: 9. 여성경제활동지원센터의 기능 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the activation of functions of the Women's Economic Activity Support Center

rows.source_ko: 10. 중앙여성경제활동지원센터의 지정ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 10. Designation and Operation of the Central Women's Economic Activity Support Center

rows.source_ko: 11. 여성경제활동지원센터 사업 관리 시스템 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the operation of the Women's Economic Activity Support Center business management system

rows.source_ko: 12. 여성경제활동지원센터 종사자 교육 및 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Training and Management of Women's Economic Activity Support Center Staff

rows.source_ko: 13. 경력단절예방을 위한 대국민 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning public awareness campaigns to prevent career interruptions

rows.source_ko: 14. 대상별 특성을 고려한 여성의 경력개발 및 취업지원
rows.text_en: 14. Career development and employment support for women considering the characteristics of each target group

rows.source_ko: 15. 청년여성의 경력개발을 위한 프로그램의 개발 및 운영ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 15. Development, operation, and support of career development programs for young women

rows.source_ko: 16. 부 내 여성 일자리 사업 총괄ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 16. Overall management and operation of women's employment projects within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 권익정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 14. The Head of the Rights and Interests Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 여성ㆍ청소년 등의 폭력 피해 예방 및 피해자 보호사업의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of projects for the prevention of violence against women and youth, and the protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 2. 여성ㆍ청소년 등 폭력피해자 보호 관련 전달체계의 구축ㆍ운영 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of the establishment and operation of delivery systems for the protection of victims of violence, including women and youth

rows.source_ko: 3. 권익침해 및 보호가 필요한 여성 등에 관한 정책개발 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 3. Policy development and institutional improvement regarding women, etc., whose rights have been infringed and who require protection

rows.source_ko: 4. 여성폭력추방주간 등 여성폭력 방지 관련 홍보 및 포상
rows.text_en: 4. Promotion and awards related to the prevention of violence against women, such as the Week for the Elimination of Violence Against Women

rows.source_ko: 5. 여성폭력방지기본법령의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 5. Management and Operation of the Framework Act on the Prevention of Violence Against Women

rows.source_ko: 6. 여성폭력 통계 구축 총괄 및 여성폭력 실태조사 등 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of statistics on violence against women and research including surveys on the actual conditions of violence against women

rows.source_ko: 7. 여성 권익증진 관련 법인ㆍ단체에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 7. Guidance and Supervision of Corporations and Organizations Related to the Promotion of Women's Rights

rows.source_ko: 8. 여성폭력방지정책 기본계획 수립 및 연도별 시행계획 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of the Basic Plan for the Prevention of Violence Against Women and Overview of Annual Implementation Plans

rows.source_ko: 9. 여성폭력방지위원회의 구성ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 9. Composition and Operation of the Committee on the Prevention of Violence Against Women

rows.source_ko: 10. 한국여성인권진흥원의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 10. Guidance and supervision by the Korea Women's Human Rights Promotion Agency

rows.source_ko: 11. 일본군위안부 피해자에 대한 생활안정지원 및 기념사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning livelihood stabilization support and commemorative projects for victims of Japanese military 'comfort women'

rows.source_ko: 12. 일본군위안부 피해자 관련 조사ㆍ연구ㆍ교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 12. Investigation, research, education, and promotion regarding Japanese military "comfort women" victims

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 성폭력방지과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 15. The Head of the Sexual Violence Prevention Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 방지 및 피해자 보호를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of plans for the prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence and the protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 2. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 방지 및 피해자 보호에 관한 법령의 관리 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 2. Management of laws and regulations and institutional improvement regarding the prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence and the protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 3. 성폭력피해자 지원을 위한 통합지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of integrated support centers for the support of victims of sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 4. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 실태에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 4. Survey and Research on the Status of Sexual Harassment and Sexual Violence

rows.source_ko: 5. 성폭력피해자보호시설 및 성폭력피해상담소의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning support for protection facilities for victims of sexual violence and counseling centers for victims of sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 6. 성폭력방지 관련시설 종사자 및 관계기관 담당자 교육
rows.text_en: 6. Training for staff at sexual violence prevention facilities and representatives from relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 7. 성폭력피해자의 의료ㆍ법률ㆍ주거 등 지원 및 치료회복프로그램 개발ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Support for victims of sexual violence regarding medical, legal, and housing matters, and development and operation of treatment and recovery programs

rows.source_ko: 8. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 예방을 위한 대국민 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning public awareness campaigns for the prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 9. 공공부문 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 근절 대책의 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overview of Measures to Eradicate Sexual Harassment and Sexual Violence in the Public Sector

rows.source_ko: 10. 공공부문 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 사건 통보, 재발방지대책 제출, 현장점검 등 공공부문 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 사건 대응 체계 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the operation of the response system for sexual harassment and sexual violence cases in the public sector, including notification of such cases, submission of measures to prevent recurrence, and on-site inspections

rows.source_ko: 11. 성희롱 방지 조직문화 진단 및 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 신고센터의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the diagnosis of organizational culture for the prevention of sexual harassment and the establishment and operation of the Sexual Harassment and Sexual Violence Reporting Center

rows.source_ko: ⑯ 디지털성범죄방지과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 16. The Head of the Digital Sexual Crime Prevention Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 디지털 성범죄 피해 방지 및 피해자 지원에 관한 정책 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the prevention of digital sexual crimes and support for victims

rows.source_ko: 2. 디지털 성범죄 피해자 지원기관의 운영 및 관리 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the operation and management, etc. of support organizations for victims of digital sexual crimes

rows.source_ko: 3. 디지털 성범죄 관련 정책 연구 및 관련 법ㆍ제도 개선
rows.text_en: 3. Policy Research on Digital Sex Crimes and Improvement of Related Laws and Systems

rows.source_ko: 4. 디지털 성범죄 예방을 위한 대국민 교육ㆍ홍보 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning public education and promotion, etc. for the prevention of digital sex crimes

rows.source_ko: 5. 디지털 성범죄 피해 지원기관 종사자 역량 제고 및 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning capacity building and training for staff at support organizations for victims of digital sexual crimes

rows.source_ko: 6. 디지털 성범죄 피해 대응 관계기관 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning cooperation with relevant agencies in responding to digital sexual crimes

rows.source_ko: 7. 아동ㆍ청소년 온라인 성착취 방지 및 피해자 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the prevention of online sexual exploitation of children and adolescents and support for victims

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 친밀관계폭력방지과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 17 The Head of the Intimate Relationship Violence Prevention Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 예방과 피해자 보호계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of plans for the prevention of domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence, and the protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 2. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 예방 및 피해자 보호 관련 법령의 관리 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 2. Management of laws and regulations and institutional improvement related to the prevention of domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence, and the protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 3. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 피해자 지원기관의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning support by support agencies for victims of domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence

rows.source_ko: 4. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 피해자 의료ㆍ법률ㆍ주거 지원 및 피해자 치료회복프로그램의 개발ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Medical, legal, and housing support for victims of domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence, and development and operation of treatment and recovery programs for victims

rows.source_ko: 5. 여성긴급전화의 운영 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning support for the operation of the Women's Emergency Hotline

rows.source_ko: 6. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 관련시설 종사자 및 관계기관 담당자 교육
rows.text_en: 6. Training for staff at facilities related to domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence, and for officials from relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 7. 이주여성 폭력피해 예방 및 보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the prevention of violence against migrant women and protection

rows.source_ko: 8. 가정폭력ㆍ스토킹ㆍ교제폭력 근절문화 확산 및 대국민 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the dissemination of a culture to eradicate domestic violence, stalking, and dating violence, and public awareness campaigns

rows.source_ko: 9. 여성장애인 폭력피해 예방 및 보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the prevention of violence against women with disabilities and protection

rows.source_ko: 10. 북한이탈여성 권익보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the protection of rights and interests of female North Korean defectors

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 폭력예방교육과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: 18. The Head of the Violence Prevention Education Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 성매매방지 및 피해자 보호를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of plans for the prevention of prostitution and protection of victims

rows.source_ko: 2. 성매매 방지 및 피해자 보호 관련 법령의 관리 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 2. Management of laws and regulations related to the prevention of prostitution and protection of victims, and institutional improvement

rows.source_ko: 3. 성매매방지중앙지원센터의 운영 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the operation, etc. of the Central Support Center for the Prevention of Prostitution

rows.source_ko: 4. 성매매피해자 등을 위한 지원시설 및 성매매피해상담소의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning support facilities for victims of prostitution, etc. and support for counseling centers for victims of prostitution

rows.source_ko: 5. 성매매방지 관련시설 종사자 및 관계기관 담당자 교육
rows.text_en: 5. Training for staff at anti-prostitution facilities and officials from relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 6. 성매매피해자 등에 대한 의료ㆍ법률 서비스 지원 및 자립 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Medical and legal service support and self-reliance support for victims of prostitution, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 성매매 예방을 위한 대국민 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning public awareness campaigns for the prevention of prostitution

rows.source_ko: 8. 성매매 등 여성폭력 방지를 위한 현장점검에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning on-site inspections for the prevention of violence against women, including prostitution

rows.source_ko: 9. 성폭력ㆍ가정폭력ㆍ성매매ㆍ성희롱 등(아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄를 포함하며, 이하 “아동ㆍ여성폭력등”이라 한다) 예방교육을 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 시행
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment, coordination, and implementation of plans for prevention education on sexual violence, domestic violence, prostitution, sexual harassment, etc. (including sexual offenses against children and adolescents; hereinafter referred to as “violence against children and women, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 10. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방교육 관련 법령의 관리 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 10. Management of laws and regulations and institutional improvement regarding prevention education on violence against children and women

rows.source_ko: 11. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방교육 실시와 그 실적 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the implementation of prevention education on violence against children and women, etc., and the management of performance results

rows.source_ko: 12. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방교육 전문강사 양성ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the training and management of specialized instructors for prevention education on violence against children and women, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방교육 프로그램의 개발ㆍ보급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the development and dissemination of prevention education programs for violence against children and women, etc.

rows.source_ko: 14. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방 인식 확산을 위한 대국민 교육ㆍ홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning public education and promotion to spread awareness of the prevention of violence against children and women, etc.

rows.source_ko: 15. 아동ㆍ여성폭력등 예방교육 관련 교육기관의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning support for educational institutions related to prevention education on violence against children and women, etc.

rows.source_ko: 16. 「인신매매등방지 및 피해자보호 등에 관한 법률」 제2조제1호에 따른 인신매매등(이하 이 항에서 “인신매매등”이라 한다) 방지에 관한 종합계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 지원
rows.text_en: 16. Establishment, coordination, and support of a comprehensive plan for the prevention of human trafficking, etc. pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention of Human Trafficking, etc. and Protection of Victims, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “human trafficking, etc.” in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 17. 인신매매등방지 및 피해자보호 등에 관한 법령의 운영 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 17. Operation of Acts and Improvement of Systems Concerning the Prevention of Human Trafficking, etc. and Protection of Victims, etc.

rows.source_ko: 18. 인신매매등 피해자 식별ㆍ보호지표 개발 및 고시 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning the development and public notification of indicators for the identification and protection of victims of human trafficking, etc.

rows.source_ko: 19. 인신매매등 피해자 보호ㆍ지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning the protection and support of victims of human trafficking, etc.

rows.source_ko: 20. 인신매매등 피해자 권익보호기관 운영 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 20. Matters concerning the operation and support of institutions for the protection of the rights and interests of victims of human trafficking, etc.

rows.source_ko: 21. 인신매매등 피해 현장조사 지원, 피해예방 교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 21. Support for on-site investigations of human trafficking and related damages, and education and publicity for damage prevention

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 아동청소년성보호과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: 19. The Head of the Child and Youth Sexual Protection Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 아동ㆍ청소년의 성보호를 위한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies for the protection of children and adolescents from sexual abuse

rows.source_ko: 2. 아동ㆍ청소년 성보호 관련 법령의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 2. Management and operation of laws and regulations related to the protection of children and adolescents from sexual abuse

rows.source_ko: 3. 아동ㆍ청소년 성보호 관련 실태에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 3. Survey and Research on the Current Status of Child and Adolescent Sexual Protection

rows.source_ko: 4. 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄자 신상정보의 공개명령 집행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the execution of orders to disclose personal information of sex offenders against children and adolescents

rows.source_ko: 5. 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄자 신상정보의 고지명령 집행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the execution of the order to notify personal information of sex offenders against children and adolescents

rows.source_ko: 6. 성범죄자 취업제한제도의 운영 및 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄 신고제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the operation of the employment restriction system for sex offenders and the operation of the reporting system for sex crimes against children and adolescents

rows.source_ko: 7. 성범죄 가해 아동ㆍ청소년의 치료 및 교육 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the treatment and education, etc. of child and adolescent perpetrators of sexual offenses

rows.source_ko: 8. 청소년성문화센터의 설치ㆍ운영 등 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning sex education for children and adolescents, such as the establishment and operation of youth sexual culture centers

rows.source_ko: 9. 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄 예방을 위한 대국민 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning public awareness campaigns for the prevention of sexual offenses against children and adolescents

rows.source_ko: 10. 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄 신고포상금제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the operation of the reward system for reporting sexual offenses against children and adolescents

rows.source_ko: 11. 「아동ㆍ청소년의 성보호에 관한 법률」 제2조제5호에 따른 아동ㆍ청소년성착취물로부터 아동ㆍ청소년의 성보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the protection of children and adolescents from child and adolescent sexual exploitation materials pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act on the Protection of Children and Adolescents from Sexual Exploitation

rows.source_ko: 12. 아동ㆍ청소년 대상 성범죄 동향 분석ㆍ공표
rows.text_en: 12. Analysis and Publication of Trends in Sexual Crimes Against Children and Adolescents

rows.source_ko: 제8조(청소년가족정책실) ① 청소년가족정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Youth and Family Policy Office) ① The Head of the Youth and Family Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「성평등가족부 직제」 제10조제1항에 따라 청소년가족정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 청소년정책관 및 가족정책관으로 하며, 청소년정책관 및 가족정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Youth and Family Policy Office shall be the Director of Youth Policy and the Director of Family Policy. The Director of Youth Policy and the Director of Family Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 청소년정책관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제10조제3항제1호부터 제23호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Youth Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 1 through 23 of Article 10 , Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 가족정책관은 「성평등가족부 직제」 제10조제3항제24호부터 제41호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Family Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 24 through 41 of Article 10 , Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 청소년가족정책실에 청소년정책과, 청소년활동진흥과, 청소년활동안전과, 청소년자립지원과, 학교밖청소년지원과, 청소년보호환경과, 가족정책과, 가족지원과, 아이돌봄지원과 및 다문화가족과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Youth and Family Policy Office shall have the Youth Policy Division, Youth Activity Promotion Division, Youth Activity Safety Division, Youth Self-Reliance Support Division, Out-of-School Youth Support Division, Youth Protection Environment Division, Family Policy Division, Family Support Division, Childcare Support Division, and Multicultural Family Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 청소년정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Youth Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 청소년정책에 관한 중장기 기본계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of mid-to-long-term basic plans regarding youth policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 중앙부처 및 지방자치단체 청소년정책의 협의ㆍ조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of consultation and coordination of youth policies among central government ministries and local governments

rows.source_ko: 3. 청소년정책 관련 법령의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 3. Management and operation of laws and regulations related to youth policy

rows.source_ko: 4. 청소년정책위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of the Youth Policy Committee

rows.source_ko: 5. 청소년정책 전담 기구ㆍ공무원 등 전달체계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the delivery system, including organizations and public officials dedicated to youth policy

rows.source_ko: 6. 관계 기관 청소년정책의 평가 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the evaluation and support of youth policies of relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 7. 청소년의 달 등 청소년 관련 행사 및 포상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning youth-related events and awards, such as Youth Month

rows.source_ko: 8. 청소년 정책 관련 조사ㆍ연구 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 8. Research and studies related to youth policy and institutional improvement

rows.source_ko: 9. 청소년 관련 통계의 유지 및 백서 등의 발간
rows.text_en: 9. Maintenance of youth-related statistics and publication of white papers, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 청소년 관련 법인ㆍ단체에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 10. Guidance and Supervision of Youth-Related Corporations and Organizations

rows.source_ko: 11. 청소년 인권 보호 등 청소년 권리증진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the promotion of youth rights, including the protection of youth human rights

rows.source_ko: 12. 청소년 특별회의 및 참여위원회 등 청소년 정책참여기구의 구성ㆍ운영 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Support for the formation and operation of youth policy participation bodies, such as the Youth Special Conference and the Participation Committee.

rows.source_ko: 13. 청소년 정책참여 활성화 프로그램의 개발ㆍ보급
rows.text_en: 13. Development and dissemination of programs to promote youth policy participation

rows.source_ko: 14. 청소년 우대정책의 수립 및 교육ㆍ홍보
rows.text_en: 14. Establishment of Youth Preferential Policies and Education and Promotion

rows.source_ko: 15. 청소년증 제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the operation of the Youth ID card system

rows.source_ko: 16. 한국청소년활동진흥원의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 16. Guidance and supervision by the Korea Youth Activity Promotion Agency

rows.source_ko: 17. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the building

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 청소년활동진흥과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Youth Activities Promotion Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 청소년 활동진흥, 역량개발 및 국제교류에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of plans regarding the promotion of youth activities, capacity development, and international exchange

rows.source_ko: 2. 청소년활동 관련 법령(청소년수련활동 안전 관련 법령은 제외한다)의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 2. Management and operation of laws and regulations related to youth activities (excluding laws and regulations related to the safety of youth training activities).

rows.source_ko: 3. 지방청소년활동진흥센터의 설치ㆍ운영 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for the establishment and operation of local youth activity promotion centers

rows.source_ko: 4. 청소년수련 프로그램ㆍ사업의 개발ㆍ보급 및 평가
rows.text_en: 4. Development, dissemination, and evaluation of youth training programs and projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 청소년의 수련활동 및 문화ㆍ예술체험 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the promotion of youth training activities and cultural and artistic experiences

rows.source_ko: 6. 청소년 축제 및 동아리 발굴ㆍ지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning youth festivals and the discovery and support of youth clubs

rows.source_ko: 7. 청소년 활동정보 제공ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 7. Provision and Support of Youth Activity Information

rows.source_ko: 8. 청소년 자원봉사 활동에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning youth volunteer activities

rows.source_ko: 9. 청소년지도사의 자격검정, 연수 및 활동 등 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Support for qualification examinations, training, and activities of youth leaders

rows.source_ko: 10. 학교교육ㆍ평생교육과 연계한 청소년 능력개발프로그램의 개발 및 시행
rows.text_en: 10. Development and implementation of youth competency development programs linked to school education and lifelong education

rows.source_ko: 11. 청소년 방과 후 아카데미 등 방과 후 활동프로그램의 개발ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 11. Development and support of after-school activity programs, such as the Youth After-School Academy

rows.source_ko: 12. 청소년의 국제교류를 위한 프로그램 개발ㆍ운영 지원 및 국제행사 개최
rows.text_en: 12. Support for the development and operation of programs for youth international exchange and hosting of international events

rows.source_ko: 13. 교포청소년 및 남ㆍ북 청소년 교류활동 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for exchange activities between overseas Korean youth and inter-Korean youth

rows.source_ko: 14. 청소년교류센터의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Youth Exchange Center

rows.source_ko: 15. 세계청소년축제 및 국제청소년 야영대회 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the hosting of the World Youth Festival and the International Youth Camping Competition

rows.source_ko: 16. 소외계층 청소년의 해외연수 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning support for overseas training for underprivileged youth

rows.source_ko: 17. 지방자치단체 및 청소년단체의 국제교류활동 협력ㆍ지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning cooperation and support for international exchange activities of local governments and youth organizations

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 청소년활동안전과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Youth Activity Safety Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 청소년수련활동 안전에 관한 정책의 총괄 및 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of policies regarding safety in youth training activities and establishment and implementation of plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 청소년수련활동 안전 관련 법령의 관리ㆍ운영 및 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the management, operation, and institutional improvement of laws and regulations related to the safety of youth training activities

rows.source_ko: 3. 숙박형ㆍ비숙박형 청소년수련활동 계획의 신고업무 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Management and Operation of Reporting Tasks for Residential and Non-residential Youth Training Activity Plans

rows.source_ko: 4. 숙박형ㆍ비숙박형 청소년수련활동 관련 정보 공개를 위한 온라인 종합정보제공 시스템 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and operation of an online comprehensive information provision system for the disclosure of information related to residential and non-residential youth training activities

rows.source_ko: 5. 청소년수련활동 인증제도의 운영ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation and management of the youth training activity certification system

rows.source_ko: 6. 청소년수련활동 이행 실태 점검 및 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the inspection of the implementation status of youth training activities and safety management

rows.source_ko: 7. 청소년활동 안전문화 확산에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the dissemination of a safety culture in youth activities

rows.source_ko: 8. 청소년수련시설 운영관리, 지도ㆍ감독 및 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the operation and management, guidance and supervision, and institutional improvement of youth training facilities

rows.source_ko: 9. 국립청소년수련원의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and Supervision of National Youth Training Centers

rows.source_ko: 10. 국립청소년수련시설의 국유재산ㆍ물품의 취득 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the acquisition and management of state-owned property and goods of national youth training facilities

rows.source_ko: 11. 청소년수련시설 종합 안전점검 실시 및 공개에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the implementation and disclosure of comprehensive safety inspections of youth training facilities

rows.source_ko: 12. 청소년수련시설 종합평가 실시 및 결과 공개에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the implementation of comprehensive evaluations of youth training facilities and the disclosure of results

rows.source_ko: 13. 청소년수련시설 종사자 안전교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning safety education for employees of youth training facilities

rows.source_ko: 14. 국립 청소년수련시설 확충계획 수립 및 건립에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the establishment of expansion plans and construction of national youth training facilities

rows.source_ko: 15. 청소년수련시설 운영 모델 개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 15. Development and Dissemination of Operation Models for Youth Training Facilities

rows.source_ko: 16. 청소년수련지구의 지정 관련 협의ㆍ자문에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning consultation and advice regarding the designation of youth training districts

rows.source_ko: 17. 한국청소년수련시설협회 지도ㆍ관리 및 감독에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the guidance, management, and supervision of the Korea Youth Training Facilities Association

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 청소년자립지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Youth Self-Reliance Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 청소년복지에 관한 정책의 총괄 및 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of policies regarding youth welfare and establishment and implementation of plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 청소년복지 관련 법령의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 2. Management and Operation of Laws Related to Youth Welfare

rows.source_ko: 3. 청소년복지서비스의 조사ㆍ연구 및 통계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the investigation, research, and statistics of youth welfare services

rows.source_ko: 4. 청소년복지시설의 운영ㆍ지원 및 청소년복지ㆍ지원업무 종사자의 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and support of youth welfare facilities and education and training of personnel engaged in youth welfare and support work

rows.source_ko: 5. 한국청소년상담복지개발원의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 5. Guidance and supervision by the Korea Youth Counseling and Welfare Development Institute

rows.source_ko: 6. 청소년상담사의 자격검정ㆍ연수 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning qualification examinations, training, etc. of youth counselors

rows.source_ko: 7. 취약계층 청소년의 보호ㆍ상담ㆍ자립 등에 대한 계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 시행
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment, coordination, and implementation of plans for the protection, counseling, and self-reliance of vulnerable youth

rows.source_ko: 8. 가정 밖 청소년에 대한 보호 및 자립지원에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: Article 9 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family by rank are as set forth in Attached Table 1. However,pursuant to the proviso to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family,” the personnel quotas for public officials by rank separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total quota set forth in Attached Table 1 are as set forth in Attached Table 2 , and one person (one Assistant Administrative Clerk) among the quotas set forth in Attached Table 2 shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Amended July 29, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 성평등가족부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 2명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 5급 1명) 및 성별영향평가를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 10명(3급 또는 4급 3명, 5급 2명, 6급 2명, 7급 1명, 9급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, 2 people in charge of public relations (1 person at Grade 4 or 5, and 1 person at Grade 5) and 1 person in charge of gender impact assessment (1 person at Grade 5), and 10 people among the other authorized number of officials (3 people at Grade 3 or 4, 2 people at Grade 5, 2 people at Grade 6, 1 person at Grade 7, and 2 people at Grade 9) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.
